goal.text: Get the living room straight before people arrive: clear the centre table onto the hutch, then dig the game things out of the cabinet and leave the rest stowed.

turns.text: How many loads have I carried across so far?

trigger.detail: an armful from the centre table has just been set down on the hutch shelf

expected_answer.text: Three so far: the books and a decorative piece, then another book, and just now the plant with the candle.

turns.text: — same shelf as the first lot?

trigger.detail: the plant and the candle are put down at the far end of the hutch

expected_answer.text: No, those went on the opposite end, the far side of the hutch from where you stacked the books.

turns.text: hold on — so is there anything still sitting on the table, or is that it?

trigger.detail: the user wants to know whether the centre table is finished before moving on

expected_answer.text: Not quite, there is one more piece on it, the decorative display you are reaching for right now.

turns.text: Shelf's finished — what's piling up down here now?

trigger.detail: the cabinet doors are open and the first load has come out onto the floor

expected_answer.text: Only boxes so far, pulled out of the cabinet and stacked on the floor just beside your left knee.

trigger.detail: another item is lifted clear and added to the pile on the left

expected_answer.text: Of course, I will note everything that comes out and the order it comes out in.

turns.text: mm-hm, mm — actually, in what order did the first few come out?

trigger.detail: fifteen seconds into the unpacking, before the pile gets long

expected_answer.text: Boxes first, both hands, and then the toy you just moved across with your right hand on its own.

turns.text: Back to that list — what's new since the pillow?

trigger.detail: something is lifted off the cabinet shelf and set down on the game board

expected_answer.text: Only one: an hour glass out of the cabinet, which you have just put down on the game board.

turns.text: oh — by the way, did I actually move that cushion anywhere, or just set it straight back down?

trigger.detail: the user doubts whether the pillow was repositioned or simply dropped again

expected_answer.text: Barely, you lifted it off the floor and set it down again about a step to your right.

turns.text: Am I taking things out still, or putting them back?

trigger.detail: the user stands, walks a couple of paces and squats back down at the cabinet

expected_answer.text: Putting back now, you carried over the boxes in both hands and set them onto the shelf inside.

turns.text: — so of the lot that came out, how much is still down on the floor?

trigger.detail: a minute of unloading and reloading has gone by without a stocktake

expected_answer.text: The toy and the organizer are still out, plus the hour glass and cards on the board.

turns.text: Game night pile sorted; what is this last one I'm pulling?

trigger.detail: both hands close on one more box at the back of the cabinet

expected_answer.text: The last box from the bottom, and your game set is now complete.
